Comment: Demonstrates the FormCapture state: suspends until a person fills in and submits the order-approval form (forms/order-approval.json, bound to the OrderApproval attribute domain). The coerced values are persisted as an EAV row under eav-data/OrderApproval and merged into the flow input at $.capturedOrder before resuming.
